display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Tokyo puts you in the captain's seat over the real Tokyo.

THE REAL TOKYO
Real satellite, elevation and map data: Tokyo Tower, the 634 m Skytree, Shinjuku, Shibuya, Ginza, Senso-ji, Tokyo Station, Odaiba, Yokohama, five bay bridges and Mt Fuji on the horizon. Two airports: Haneda and Narita.

A LIVING CITY
Shinkansen bullet trains, the green Yamanote line, thousands of cars, water buses, ships, airliners in the sky. At night the neon of Shibuya and Shinjuku comes alive, cherry blossoms in the parks.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
A real-sounding radio: taxi and takeoff clearances, departure, traffic calls, the ILS and your landing clearance, with chatter between airliners.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar on the bay, the Rainbow Bridge and Tokyo Tower out of the doors. Walk around, repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with walk-through cabins, a midsize jet with yokes and a twin-engine fighter.

MISSIONS AND FREE FLIGHT
Eleven missions: the Haneda city approach, Narita, a bay run, a skyline run into Shinjuku, the Gate Bridge, a fighter scramble, neon nights and a Tokyo tour.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
